Multiple Value Custom Fields — Edit

Create a custom field with predefined dropdown options.

Multiple value fields ensure data consistency by limiting input to specific choices.

Name

Enter the name of this multiple value custom field. This label appears on forms and reports.

Multiple value fields let users select several options from a predefined list, like tags or categories.

Position

Enter a position number to control the display order. Lower numbers appear first.

Multiple value fields work well for categorization and can appear anywhere on the form.

Placement

Select where this multiple value field should appear. You can assign it to multiple forms or line items.

Perfect for: product categories on inventory, service types on invoices, tags on customers.

Options

Enter the available options. Users can select multiple values from this list.

Add each option as a separate entry. Users can select any combination of these options.

Examples: For 'Product Features' field, add options like 'Waterproof', 'Recyclable', 'Organic'.

Description

Enter help text that appears below the field. This guides users on which options to select.

Explain whether all applicable options should be selected or if there are limits.

Exclude from copying or cloning

Check this box to prevent selected values from being copied when duplicating records.

Enable if the selections are unique to each record and shouldn't carry over.

Locked for manual editing

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being edited by users.

This is typically used when custom field is updated by extension rather than users directly.

Show custom field on printed documents

Check this box to show the selected values on the View screen after saving.

Multiple selections will display as a comma-separated list on the View screen.

Show at the top of printed documents

If displayed on View, check this box to show the field at the top of the View screen.

Use for important categorizations or tags that need immediate visibility.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this multiple value field. It won't appear on new forms but existing data is preserved.

Previously selected values remain in records and can still be used in reports and searches.
